attributes.title: tag_write
attributes.description: Write current Tag values via system.tag.writeBlocking: one bounded batch, scalars and arrays of scalars only (Dataset and Document values are invalid_argument). The per-item Native outcome is the result's QualityCode; a bounded read-back is returned as Observed state and never decides success, so the outcomes are still reported when the Observed state is over its budget or cannot be serialized. Reads the Runtime Target Policy first and fails closed with operation_disabled when it is missing or unusable; a target outside the tag_write Target allowlist, or inside the reserved IgnitionMCPPolicy provider (whatever the allowlist says, including an explicit *), fails with permission_denied before anything executes and records one audit decision row. Preflight checks every item before any item runs, with no rollback. Runtime audit follows the policy's auditMode; a failed post-write audit reports auditRecorded=false and stays a success. D28 ignition-null-v1 encodes logical null as {"$ignition":"null"}. D10: the default batch is 20 items, raisable by the policy's tagWriteMaxWrites up to the hard maximum of 100; a path is at most 2048 bytes, a string value at most 16384 bytes, an array at most 1000 elements and a batch at most 65536 bytes of input, and an over-budget request fails with limit_exceeded, the requested amount and the limit. Example: {"writes":[{"path":"[default]AHU/AHU01/Setpoint","value":22}]}.

parameters.name: writes
parameters.description: 1..100 write items: {"path": provider-qualified current Tag value path, "value": scalar or array of scalars}. Default 20 (D10), raisable to the hard maximum of 100 by the Runtime Target Policy's tagWriteMaxWrites; at most 2048 bytes per path and 16384 bytes per string value.
